en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned town square lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings in traditional Central European style. Shops occupy the ground floors, with signs in German on the facades. Visible texts include a central shop sign reading "Traugott Scheibe" and another larger sign on the right‑hand building advertising a gentlemen's clothing store. On the far right, commercial signage with the name "Albert" appears. In the background to the right rises a church or town‑hall tower with a clock and a cross on top. The square is almost empty, with only a few indistinct pedestrians.
